correctness.rationale: Opposite bits along a rung of a fixed majority coloring force constant, oppositely oriented rails; the Möbius seam excludes those two extra states. Uniform rung bits give cyclic singleton-free binary words, counted by trace(T^n)=R_n=L_n+2cos(n pi/3) from characteristic polynomial (z²−z−1)(z²−z+1). Temporal bipartite double cover gives Fix(F_G²) bijective to fixed majority colorings of B(G): B(P_n)=two P_n if n even, else P_2n; B(M_n)=two M_n if n odd, else P_2n. Therefore the exact q_P,q_M and b=(q−f)/2 formulas follow. Integer energy H_t for symmetric odd-degree majority proves eventual period<=2. Lucas identity L_2n=L_n²−2(−1)^n gives the piecewise b_P−b_M. Independent microscopic adjacency majority enumeration of both labelled families for n=3..6 agreed, but all-n claims rely on analytic transfer/cover proof.
